documents.label: HSA Fall Nut Roll Sale — seller order sheet
facts: Each HSA Fall Nut Roll costs $20 and must be prepaid by cash or check made out to Assumption B.V.M.

Pickup is Tuesday, November 17, 2026 during a designated pickup window; the flyer does not specify the hour.
Sellers earn $2 in Tuition Bucks per nut roll sold.
Families should arrange pickup for November 17; the notice says orders cannot be saved for a later pickup.

documents.label: HSA Fall Nut Roll Sale — additional order sheet
facts: The additional HSA Fall Nut Roll Sale sheet confirms prepaid $20 orders due Friday, October 30, 2026 and pickup Tuesday, November 17, 2026.

Each nut roll sold earns $2 in Tuition Bucks.
This is another sheet for the same fundraiser, not a second sale.

documents.label: ABVM diocesan Eucharistic Consecration family letter dated October 6
facts: The schools' diocesan Eucharistic Consecration journey runs October 20 through December 8, 2026.
Consecration occurs Tuesday, December 8 during the ABVM school Mass for the Immaculate Conception.
Each student and one parent receive complementary age-appropriate reading copies; weekly reading guidance will follow.

Optional Holy Hours: Thursday, October 22 at 7 PM at Bethlehem Catholic High School; Tuesday, November 3 at 6 PM at Nativity BVM High School, Pottsville; Tuesday, November 17 at 7 PM at Berks Catholic High School.
Diocesan Family Festival: Sunday, November 1 from noon to 4:30 PM at St. Joseph the Worker, Orefield; free family event.
